links.outcome: 90-day mortality prediction discrimination of GPT-4 versus supervised ML models on same cohort
links.effect: GPT-4 AUC 0.89 (95% CI 0.8077-0.9739), outperforming PRACTICE (AUC 0.70; log-rank P=.02) and PREMISE (AUC 0.77; P=.07).
links.quote: For mortality prediction, GPT-4 accurately identified 10 (77%) out of 13 deaths within its top 25 high-risk predictions (AUC 0.89, 95% CI 0.8077-0.9739; hazard ratio 6.98, 95% CI 2.88-16.9; P<.001), outperforming supervised machine learning models such as PRACTICE (AUC 0.70; log-rank P=.02) and PREMISE (AUC 0.77; P=.07).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and agreement of GPT-4 against stroke specialists and real-world outcomes using 100 patient cases, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
